boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California Institute of Technology
boards.description: Ten currently documented late-night food and activity destinations in Pasadena, selected for under-21 access and clear official hours.

cards.title: Prince Street Pizza
cards.subtitle: 49 E Colorado Blvd, Pasadena
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check the day before heading out; Friday and Saturday service is listed through 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A Colorado Boulevard pizza stop with documented weekend late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Pasadena location page lists Friday and Saturday hours from 11 AM to 2 AM and identifies the address as 49 E Colorado Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed open until 2 AM Friday and Saturday; confirm before travel.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on North Lake
cards.subtitle: 1269 N Lake Ave, Pasadena
cards.notes: For a late pickup or delivery option, start from the official Pasadena location directory and verify availability for your address.
cards.short_summary: A North Lake pizza location officially listed as open until 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official Pasadena directory lists the 1269 N Lake Ave location as open until 2 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official directory lists this location open until 2 AM; ordering modes may vary.

cards.title: Tatsu Ramen
cards.subtitle: 319 S Arroyo Pkwy #9, Pasadena
cards.notes: Check the day-specific schedule before leaving: the official page lists later Thursday–Saturday hours than the rest of the week.
cards.short_summary: Ramen with documented midnight service most nights and 2 AM service Thursday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Tatsu Ramen’s official late-night page lists Pasadena hours until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and until 2 AM Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and 2 AM Thursday–Saturday, per the official page.

cards.title: Lucky Boy Burgers
cards.subtitle: 640 S Arroyo Pkwy, Pasadena
cards.notes: This is the Arroyo location, not the Walnut location; use its official page for the daily midnight closing time.
cards.short_summary: An Arroyo Parkway food stop listed open every day through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Lucky Boy’s official locations page lists its Arroyo location at 640 S Arroyo Parkway and hours of 5 AM–12 AM Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed open daily from 5 AM to 12 AM.

cards.title: Shake Shack
cards.subtitle: 750 S Arroyo Pkwy, Pasadena
cards.notes: Plan around the official schedule: Sunday through Thursday closes at midnight, while Friday and Saturday run one hour later.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Arroyo Parkway burger stop with later Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Shake Shack’s official Pasadena page lists hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: midnight Sunday–Thursday; 1 AM Friday and Saturday.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 1415 E Colorado Blvd
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Colorado
cards.subtitle: 1415 E Colorado Blvd, Pasadena
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when arriving after the lobby closes; the official page separates the midnight lobby schedule from overnight service.
cards.short_summary: A Colorado Boulevard location with a 24-hour drive-thru schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box’s official page lists the 1415 E Colorado Blvd drive-thru from 4 AM to 4 AM daily and the lobby until midnight.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 1415 E Colorado Blvd
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed 24 hours daily; lobby is listed until 12 AM.

cards.title: Taco Bell on East Colorado
cards.subtitle: 1953 E Colorado Blvd, Pasadena
cards.notes: For after-midnight orders, use the drive-thru rather than assuming dining-room access; the official listing gives separate hours.
cards.short_summary: An East Colorado drive-thru officially scheduled through 4 AM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official 1953 E Colorado Blvd page lists drive-thru hours from 7 AM to 4 AM every day and dine-in hours until 10 PM.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 4 AM daily; dine-in is listed until 10 PM.

cards.title: Lucky Strike Pasadena
cards.subtitle: 3545 E Foothill Blvd, Pasadena
cards.notes: Reserve a lane or confirm walk-in availability before going; the venue’s current weekly schedule lists Friday and Saturday through midnight.
cards.short_summary: A bowling-and-arcade destination with documented midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Lucky Strike’s official Pasadena page lists 31 bowling lanes, an arcade, and hours until 12 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official weekly hours list Friday 2 PM–12 AM and Saturday 11 AM–12 AM; bowling requires payment.

cards.title: IHOP on South Arroyo
cards.subtitle: 880 S Arroyo Pkwy, Pasadena
cards.notes: A useful sit-down option when other kitchens have closed; check the official page before departure for any holiday or temporary changes.
cards.short_summary: A South Arroyo restaurant officially listed open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official location page lists the restaurant at 880 S Arroyo Pkwy as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed open 24 hours every day.

cards.title: Del Taco on North Lake
cards.subtitle: 765 N Lake Ave, Pasadena
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to confirm current service before heading north on Lake Avenue, especially around holiday schedules.
cards.short_summary: A North Lake restaurant officially listed open until 2:30 AM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco’s official 765 N Lake Ave page lists store and delivery hours from 7 AM until 2:30 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Del Taco — 765 N Lake Ave, Pasadena
cards.access_notes: Officially listed open until 2:30 AM daily.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named Pasadena destinations on distinct nearby corridors, each with a source-backed reason to stop.

cards.title: Pasadena Playhouse
cards.subtitle: S. El Molino Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Check the current performance calendar, then use the box office at the historic theater on South El Molino Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A historic theater stop on the El Molino corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Pasadena Playhouse is located at 39 S. El Molino Avenue and includes a 643-seat historic theater.
cards.access_notes: Performances and ticket availability vary; consult the Playhouse calendar or box office before visiting.

cards.title: Playhouse Village Park
cards.subtitle: E. Union Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the paths and open grass area for a daytime pause; the city lists restrooms and a drinking fountain on site.
cards.short_summary: A city park with paths, open space, and practical amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Playhouse Village Park at 701 E. Union Street has open grass, paths, a playground, dog areas, restrooms, and drinking fountains.
cards.access_notes: City-listed park hours are daily, 6:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: USC Pacific Asia Museum
cards.subtitle: N. Los Robles Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit around the Wednesday–Sunday schedule, or choose a second Sunday when the museum lists free admission.
cards.short_summary: Asian and Pacific arts museum on North Los Robles.
cards.evidence_claim: USC Pacific Asia Museum is at 46 N. Los Robles Avenue, is open Wednesday–Sunday, and lists free admission every second Sunday.
cards.source_title: Visit Us — USC Pacific Asia Museum
cards.access_notes: Regular admission applies except listed free-admission periods; hours are Wednesday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Pasadena Convention Center
cards.subtitle: E. Green Street corridor
cards.notes: Look up the public event calendar before heading to the campus; the official directions identify the Civic Auditorium at this address.
cards.short_summary: A Green Street event campus anchored by the Civic Auditorium.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pasadena Convention Center is at 300 E. Green Street, and official directions place Pasadena Civic Auditorium at that address.
cards.source_title: Parking & Directions to the Pasadena Convention Center
cards.access_notes: Entry and cost depend on the specific scheduled event.

cards.title: Norton Simon Museum
cards.subtitle: W. Colorado Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Set aside time for the galleries and sculpture garden; students with ID and visitors 18 and under are listed for free admission.
cards.short_summary: An art-museum stop at Colorado and Orange Grove.
cards.evidence_claim: Norton Simon Museum is at 411 W. Colorado Boulevard; admission is free for students with ID and everyone age 18 and under.
cards.source_title: Norton Simon Museum — Plan Your Visit
cards.access_notes: The museum lists hours Sunday, Monday, Thursday 12–5 p.m. and Friday–Saturday 12–7 p.m.; it is closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

cards.title: The Gamble House
cards.subtitle: Westmoreland Place corridor
cards.notes: Walk by the house and gardens, then reserve ahead if you want the guided interior tour rather than an exterior visit.
cards.short_summary: A preserved house museum on Westmoreland Place.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gamble House is at 4 Westmoreland Place; visitors may explore its exterior and gardens, while house visits are by tour.
cards.access_notes: Tours run Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday; advance ticketing is recommended.

cards.title: Kidspace Children's Museum
cards.subtitle: N. Arroyo Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Bring younger relatives for the outdoor campus and check the daily exhibit availability before purchasing admission.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on children’s museum on North Arroyo Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Kidspace Children’s Museum is at 480 N. Arroyo Boulevard and describes its site as a 3.5-acre outdoor campus.
cards.access_notes: The museum lists daily hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; paid admission is generally required.

cards.title: Rose Bowl Stadium
cards.subtitle: Rose Bowl Drive corridor
cards.notes: Check the stadium’s tour or event schedule before making the trip to the landmark venue on Rose Bowl Drive.
cards.short_summary: A National Historic Landmark stadium destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Rose Bowl Stadium is at 1001 Rose Bowl Drive and is recognized as a National Historic Landmark.
cards.access_notes: Tour and event access depend on the current schedule and ticketing.

cards.title: Arlington Garden
cards.subtitle: Arlington Drive corridor
cards.notes: Take the marked paths through the public garden in daylight, and leave flowers, fruit, and planted areas undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A free public garden for a quiet daylight walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Arlington Garden is a three-acre public garden, open seven days a week during daylight hours and free to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open during daylight hours and closed after dark; follow the garden’s posted etiquette and stay on marked paths.

cards.title: Pasadena City College Colorado Campus
cards.subtitle: E. Colorado Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use the public campus map to locate a scheduled arts, athletics, or community event before heading east on Colorado Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed college campus with public event venues.
cards.evidence_claim: Pasadena City College's Colorado Campus is at 1570 E. Colorado Boulevard and lists public event venues including its theater, auditorium, observatory, and gallery.
cards.access_notes: Campus facilities and event access vary; consult the college’s current calendar and campus map.
